findings.title: Define the radian angle factor before the arc-length formulas
findings.zhExactAnchor: 两段弧对应同一个圆心角，按弧长与半径的关系，屏上的弧长为：
findings.enExactAnchor: Both arcs subtend the same angle at their centers, so the arc-length relation gives the screen's arc length:
findings.reason: The individual relations AB=R alpha and ab=r alpha require the common angle factor to be the angle in radians, meaning arc length divided by radius. Saying only 'same central angle' leaves its unit/definition unspecified and invites substitution of degrees. An eight-year-old reading the text alone cannot infer that missing condition from an unapproved diagram. Attribution to the old textbook does not supply the missing mathematical meaning.
findings.whatIsNotWrong: The preserved ratio K=AB/ab=R/r and 2 x 10^6 result remain correct in the radial projection model; a common degree conversion would cancel in the ratio. The finding concerns the independently asserted intermediate arc-length equations, not a fabricated source arithmetic error.
